sourceDescription: Frozen confidence analysis and independently graded final submissions used in the paper.
policySource: Paper main cohorts, including the updated β=0.5 UCB cohorts.
limitations: Recorded examples; moving the slider filters predictions and does not regenerate them.
Confidence is an outcome-class score, not a calibrated probability of terminal or metric correctness.
Terminal agreement averages three frozen judge votes; the metric panel uses ≤5% relative error.
Offline coverage is not measured online execution savings.
Policy settings are separately run cohorts. Base AIDE is the historical reference.
Final solutions are chosen by real validation, never by private-test score.
Missing or invalid final submissions remain in the denominator with zero percentile.
Execution hours sum interpreter attempts and recovery cleanup, excluding model inference.
